description: The server’s re-check of a synced sale (sync spec §6.2, SYN-03, W1-07): findings, never a refusal. Every case runs as device C03 in Asia/Karachi with the 04:00 cutoff, Rs 1 rounding and Delux’s payment methods. Staff on the server: …a1 the seller (salesman, 10% limit); …a2 a manager (pos.override.approve up to 50%, pos.price.below_floor); …a3 a supervisor (pos.override.approve up to 20%, no below floor); …a4 no approval rights; …a9 is unknown. The documents are built by buildSaleDocument and then changed by hand where a case needs it.

cases.name: a clean bill at list, paid in exact cash: no findings
a 5% discount, within the seller’s 10% limit: no findings
a price above list: no findings
cash with change: no findings
Raast with a reference: no findings
15% off with no approval: past the seller’s 10% limit
15% off approved by a manager whose limit is 50%: no findings
25% off approved by a supervisor whose limit is 20%: not permitted
15% off approved by someone without pos.override.approve: not permitted
15% off approved by someone the server doesn’t know: not permitted
below the floor, approved by a manager with pos.price.below_floor: no findings
below the floor, approved by a supervisor without pos.price.below_floor: not permitted
below the floor with no approval on the document
below the floor, sold under the price the approval covered: not covered
below the floor, approved only as below list: not covered
an approval for a line number that isn’t on the bill counts for nothing
an unknown floor: the list price is the floor, so 5% off without approval is below the floor
an item without a list price, approved by a manager: no findings
an item without a list price and no approval
a 15% bill discount over two lines with no approval: the bill is past the seller’s limit
a 15% bill discount approved by a manager: no findings
a bill approval that names a line not on the bill doesn’t cover the discount
a 5% bill discount, within the seller’s limit: no findings
a seller unknown to the server has no limit, so even 5% off needs an approval
a number that isn’t this device’s
a number that doesn’t match the sequence
a business date that isn’t the day createdAt falls in (15:15 in Karachi on 2 Nov)
line numbers that don’t run 1, 2, …
a line total that isn’t amount − bill share
bill shares that aren’t the allocation of the bill discount
a subtotal that isn’t the sum of the list amounts
a tax total that isn’t 0
a bill discount larger than the lines: amounts and rounding, and no price check on it
a rounding that isn’t what the increment gives
payments that don’t add up to the total
Raast without a reference
on account with no customer
change that isn’t cash received − the cash amount
a cash due that isn’t the cash payment
a handover status that doesn’t follow the cash due
consistency findings come first, then prices
a sale on account with a credit approval (W1-09): the credit override is not a price approval, no findings
